title: COMP Xform Page
summary: Official Derivative common Xform page reference for Object Component world-space transforms, transform and rotation order, translate/rotate/scale/pivot channels, parent transform source, look-at targeting, path SOP motion, up vectors, and auto-banking.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs to set or explain an Object Component transform in world space.
Transform order changes the matrix equation; for column-vector convention, Scale-Rotate-Translate is expressed as T * R * S * Position.
Use Look At to orient one Object Component toward another; a Null COMP is a common invisible center-of-interest target for Camera COMP workflows.
Use Look At Up Vector or quaternions when look-at animation crosses the target axis and needs stable orientation.
Use Path SOP, pos, roll, pathorient, up, and bank when a camera or object should follow a SOP path.
